plan: Built off the leaders' crack line. The twins' machine is Trick Room plus Psychic Terrain, so the party is deliberately slow and Steel or Dark: under Trick Room a 45-50 base Speed Kingambit and Ting-Lu move before every twin, Steel resists both Pixilate Hyper Voice and Expanding Force, and Dark is immune to the Psychic half outright. Meteor Mash and Make It Rain are 2x on Tapu Lele, Hatterene and Mega Gardevoir. Vessel of Ruin is a permanent 25 percent cut to Meteor Beam, Specs Psychic and Hyper Voice. Amoonguss' Spore is not stopped by Psychic Terrain (only Electric Terrain blocks sleep) and Rage Powder targets itself so the priority block does not apply; it is the answer to Cresselia's second Trick Room. Urshifu is the fast closer once the five turns lapse. No Wide Guard user was needed: every spread move the twins own is resisted or nullified by the Steel/Dark core.
